derivation: Choose actual active domains, current claims, incident scope and dependency impact; include additional product-specific questions. Missing source stays unknown, never fabricated.

questions.question: Did the player learn the action independently of dismissing the tutorial?
questions.signals: First useful action, assistance, errors, dropoff and successful transfer in a new encounter
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: First-time players eligible for this skill, with the same build and teaching version and an observed sample
questions.evidence_needed: Actual first-use observation and the relevant event funnel
questions.misinterpretation_control: Measure transfer independently from completing screens. Keep the intended response out of coaching.

questions.question: Why did players return or leave, and what goal did they find?
questions.signals: Actual return windows, next-goal visibility, lapsed recovery, selected voluntary objective
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Actual return cohort, explicit calendar or rolling retention method, and acquisition and build filters
questions.evidence_needed: Query or export and consented qualitative follow-up where available
questions.misinterpretation_control: One report of «повернувся б» measures intent. If no data source exists, provide a diagnosis plan.

questions.question: Do different situations produce different choices?
questions.signals: Context, build and route choice distributions, outcomes of the strongest simple strategy, and causal counterexamples
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Available learned tools and progression tier. Account for self-selection and mastery.
questions.evidence_needed: runtime replay/model experiments + real behavior where available
questions.misinterpretation_control: Measure dominance independently from popularity. Low use may reflect low visibility or limited access.

questions.question: Does framing support the important action?
questions.signals: Off-screen failures, occlusion/transition/input-cancel reports, observed anticipation visibility
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Named camera, device, aspect and config. Separate ambiguous reports from reproduced cases.
questions.misinterpretation_control: Assess feel independently from crash rates. Derive on-screen character size from the game and action.

questions.question: Can players read the challenge and choose different effective counters?
questions.signals: Deaths/counters by action/encounter family; reaction/telegraph evidence; unavoidable chains
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Matched content, progression and device tiers with gear and mastery considered
questions.misinterpretation_control: Measure novel behavior independently from HP or enemy count. Include enemies only where they fit.

questions.question: Do the world and routes support meaningful choices?
questions.signals: Risk-route selection/escape/reward outcomes; interactive-state use; unreachable seed incidents
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Eligible routes, tools and objectives, with content seed and version recorded
questions.misinterpretation_control: Measure distinct experiences separately from seed count. Keep optional revisits voluntary.

questions.question: Where does progression unlock new possibilities or stall?
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Never-pay, skill and time cohorts with declared assumptions and real versus simulated data separated
questions.evidence_needed: model acquisition simulations + runtime/live progression evidence
questions.misinterpretation_control: Check the tails of time to unlock. Verify change in capability separately from increased numbers.

questions.question: Does each retained property have a purpose and a context where it is less effective?
questions.signals: Build viability, property effect/counterexamples, stack/cap violations, collection synergies
questions.evidence_needed: model/property checks + scenario replay; live context when present
questions.misinterpretation_control: Before removing a rarely used option, check unlock access, learning and compatibility.

questions.question: Are rewards reliable and understandable, and do they open a useful next step?
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Reward ID/version/type; eligible claims denominator; offline/retry dedupe
questions.evidence_needed: ledger/state traces + runtime/human evidence + live query when available
questions.misinterpretation_control: Verify durable grants and perceived value independently from reward animation completion.

questions.question: What happens after players master the finite launch content?
questions.signals: Remaining meaningful goals, encounter repetition, exhaustion/abandon, voluntary return
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Actual progression and availability, content cadence and production capacity
questions.misinterpretation_control: Verify meaningful variety beyond seed counts and ongoing production capacity before promising weekly content.

questions.question: Does this offer create clear recurring value?
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Exact offer/catalog/local price/duration/caps; exposure denominator; sandbox excluded
questions.evidence_needed: store/server truth + UI events + human comprehension
questions.misinterpretation_control: Evaluate conversion with repeat value, fairness and churn. Track a declined offer separately from failure.

questions.question: Can combined purchases or boosts bypass rules or undermine free play?
questions.signals: Cumulative access/power/attempt budgets; overlap/expiry; no-offer outcomes; strongest synergy
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Never-pay/no-offer/full-paid portfolios; skill/time/content normalized where possible
questions.evidence_needed: simulation/counterexample fixtures + runtime; relevant live cohorts
questions.misinterpretation_control: Evaluate the full paid portfolio. Verify horizontal balance beyond equal DPS.

questions.question: Are ads voluntary and reliable?
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Eligible placement/cohort/device/consent/version; server truth where available
questions.evidence_needed: runtime/sdk/SSV sanitized records + live aggregates if actual
questions.misinterpretation_control: Keep modeled impressions separate from actual revenue. No-fill preserves normal free play.

questions.question: Does the changed game still meet the technical and creative requirements?
questions.signals: Crash/ANR/save issues; frame-time tails/thermal/memory/input/audio/haptic; fidelity drift
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Named devices/build/config/scene/quality tier; comparable measurement conditions
questions.misinterpretation_control: Use physical devices for feel and thermal claims and actual listening for audio claims.

questions.question: Is there sufficient evidence for a causal conclusion?
questions.signals: Primary metric effect/uncertainty, exposure quality, guardrails and practical significance
questions.evidence_needed: actual experiment/query records; or label observational only
questions.misinterpretation_control: Use prespecified stopping criteria instead of stopping at a favorable p-value. Report uncertainty, including small samples.

questions.question: Can the product be supported within the actual budget?
questions.signals: Fixed/variable/after-free-tier costs, content/QA capacity, alerts delivery, outage recovery
questions.cohort_denominator_requirements: Current provider terms/time window/real usage; selected services only
questions.evidence_needed: provider export/terms + cost model assumptions + actual alert test
questions.misinterpretation_control: Verify external backend and API charges independently of ChatGPT or Codex plans. Distinguish projected and incurred costs.
